description:
About Abacum

Abacum is the AI-native business planning platform for scaling enterprises. We bring an organization's data, business logic, and business context into one governed place, and put agents to work on it. Most planning platforms were built for a finance team to manage and maintain by hand, with AI added later. Abacum was built for AI to do the work from day one, so finance can steer the business every week instead of reporting on it every quarter.

Founded in 2020 by two former CFOs, we’ve grown into a global team of 100+ people across 30+ nationalities. Headquartered in New York, we have offices in Toronto and Barcelona. We’re trusted by industry leaders such as Dish Networks, Strava, BetterUp, Kajabi, JG Wentworth, Abridge, Cortex, and hundreds more.

We have raised over $100m, closing in June 2025 our $60M Series B, led by Scale Venture Partners, with the strong participation of Cathay Innovation, Y Combinator, Atomico, Creandum, and angel operators from Adyen, Zapier, and Twitch.

Our mission is ambitious and we can’t do it alone - join Abacum as we build the future of Business Planning!

The role

Abacum ships fast, and every launch deserves a story that cuts through. We're hiring a Product Marketing Manager to run our major launches from brief to market, own the product content we publish across video, web and blog, and get it in front of the right buyers through our distribution engine.

You'll design the launch programs that put Abacum in front of finance leaders, write the messaging, and set the quality bar for everything we publish, for people and for the AI engines that now answer buyers' questions. You'll hit the ground running with minimal ramp, and you'll use AI every day to excel.

You won't do it alone. You'll report to the Head of Product Marketing and work alongside a product marketer focused on product and field readiness, a Solutions Consulting team with deep finance expertise, and Growth, Partners and Design teams who run the channels. That frees you to focus on what you do best: marketing that moves the market.

  • Reports to: Matthew Sledge, Head of Product Marketing

  • Focus: Launches, content and distribution

  • Background: Product marketing at a fast-moving B2B software company. Finance or office-of-the-CFO experience is a strong plus

What you'll do

Launches

  • Run our major product launches end to end: take the product brief and own the messaging, launch plan, assets and coordination across Product, Sales, Customer Success, Growth and Design.

  • Design launch programs that cut through the market: the story, the angle and the offer. Then hand off smoothly to Growth, who run the campaigns and channels.

  • Write launch messaging within Abacum's positioning, including the core story and headline options other teams can build from.

  • Build the sales kit for every launch: talk tracks, one-pagers, BDR snippets and objection handling, working with GTM Enablement.

  • Turn product capabilities into finance use cases buyers recognize: budgeting, forecasting, headcount planning, board reporting and variance analysis.

Content and distribution

  • Be the central owner of Abacum's product content across video, web and blog, from the content calendar to the final cut.

  • Own content quality for people first and for AI second: keep the inputs AI answer engines draw on (AEO) accurate, clear and current with our value props and positioning.

  • Review content drafted by other teams, say what's wrong with it and fix it.

  • Build our content strategy and distribution with channel owners: know every channel we have, how to use each one, and how to get our product content maximum impact in market, including our prospect newsletter.

  • Turn customer proof into stories, videos and web content.

  • Automate the tactical with AI, so your time goes to strategy and story.

Analyst relations

  • Coordinate our analyst relations program: the briefing calendar, submission deadlines, questionnaire drafts and materials for Gartner and other firms.

What you bring

  • Product marketing experience at a B2B software company that ships fast. You've run launches end to end and can show what they delivered.

  • Deep marketing chops. You know launches, campaigns, content and distribution inside out, and you know what to deliver without being told.

  • AI literacy. You use AI tools every day to research, write and build, and you understand how AI answer engines find and present content.

  • A sharp eye for content quality. You can review anyone's work, say what's wrong with it and fix it.

  • Clear writing. You turn a complex product into a short, specific message, and you can show published examples.

  • Proof of building. You can show live things you made yourself: a product video, a web page, an interactive demo or a tool. Bring links.

  • Comfort in production. You can script and produce a product video without a production team, on camera or behind it.

  • Organization under pressure. You keep launches, the content calendar and analyst deadlines moving at the same time.

  • A cross-functional working style. You work directly with Product, Sales, Customer Success and Growth and keep them aligned on one story.

Nice to have

  • You've marketed to finance or office-of-the-CFO buyers, especially upmarket.

  • You have hands-on finance or FP&A experience, or you've bought or used planning software.

  • You've built AI workflows or agents that are in real use.

Benefits

  • Competitive compensation including equity package

  • Competitive vacation policy

  • Medical Insurance

  • L&D budget

  • Access to Meditopia (wellbeing platform)

  • Language courses (English / Spanish)

Our Values

Customer Obsession: Our purpose is to create value for the finance teams we serve. We pour our energy into driving impact for them fast, and we measure our success by theirs.

Relentless Ambition: We chose to compete at the top alongside the best. We set ambitious goals, and keep pushing when it gets hard. Nothing worth having comes easy.

One Team: There is no “they” at Abacum: “their” problem is our problem. We’re candid because we care, we help each other grow, and we embrace different perspectives.

Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, or disability status.
